title: Eric Davis DIA report on teleportation

tellings.quote: is so important. It speak something to that uh that Dr. Eric W. Davis uh published in one of those DIA reports that I saw in teleportage

plain: A scientist named Eric W. Davis wrote a report on teleportation for the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Pentagon's military intelligence arm. Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents for unusual craft designs, tells Michels he saw it among "those DIA reports" and points to it as backing for his own ideas. He describes the report but quotes nothing from it.
